description: This file defines the 'FileHandle' class, which manages file chunks, reading, writing, deletion, and metadata operations within a file storage system, as part of the Notesnook project.

classes.name: FileHandle
classes.description: A class for handling file chunks, providing methods for reading, writing, deleting, and managing file metadata within a storage system.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the FileHandle class with storage, file, and chunks.

methods.name: readable
methods.description: Returns a ReadableStream for reading the file data.

methods.name: writeable
methods.description: Returns a WritableStream for writing data to the file.

methods.name: writeChunkAtOffset
methods.description: Writes a chunk of data at a specific offset.

methods.name: addAdditionalData
methods.description: Adds additional metadata to the file.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes all chunks and metadata associated with the file.

methods.name: getChunkKey
methods.description: Generates a chunk key based on filename and offset.

methods.name: readChunk
methods.description: Reads a specific chunk by offset.

methods.name: readChunks
methods.description: Reads multiple chunks starting from a specific offset.

methods.name: toBlob
methods.description: Converts all chunks into a Blob object.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Calculates the total size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: listChunks
methods.description: Lists all chunk identifiers for the file.
